name: Tropical Storm
storyline: You play as an elite commander, set up on the mission to destroy the allied association of Marxist rebels, drug running Fascist insurgents, and terrorists from the Greenland Liberation Army. What makes your mission hard is the allies are using ancient Marxist reincarnation technology, to re-appear at bunkers healthy and well, only a few seconds after you've killed them. In each mission, you have only one objective: to destroy the bunkers with your grenades without being killed.
summary: Tropical Storm is a freeware, independent 3D title where the levels and enemy soldiers are dynamically created from a variety of levels (up to 9999 levels). The player can also generate random profile names and save them.
